source_snapshot.title: Dubai Government announces Eid Al Etihad holiday from 2nd to 4th December
source_snapshot.text: DUBAI, 17th November, 2026 (WAM) -- The Dubai Government Human Resources Department (DGHR) has announced that the 55th Eid Al Etihad holiday for Dubai Government entities, departments and institutions will run from Wednesday, 2nd December, to Friday, 4th December, 2026, with official working hours resuming on Monday, 7th December.The holiday excludes employees working shifts or in roles involving public services and the operation of public utilities. Each entity will determine their working hours according to operational requirements to ensure uninterrupted services throughout the holiday.DGHR extended its congratulations to the UAE leadership, citizens and residents on the occasion, reaffirming its pride in the nation's achievements and the Founding Fathers' legacy of unity and belonging, and wishing the UAE continued security, stability, prosperity and progress.

source_verification.reason: All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.

claims.claim: The Eid Al Etihad holiday in Dubai is from 2 to 4 December 2026.
The Dubai government announced the holiday for government entities from 2 to 4 December 2026.
Official work will resume on 7 December 2026.
The holiday does not apply to employees working shifts or in public services and utilities.
Each department will determine its working hours to ensure uninterrupted services.

DUBAI, 17th November, 2026 (WAM) -- The Dubai Government Human Resources Department (DGHR) has announced that the 55th Eid Al Etihad holiday for Dubai Government entities, departments and institutions will run from Wednesday, 2nd December, to Friday, 4th December, 2026, with official working hours resuming on Monday, 7th December.The holiday excludes employees working shifts or in roles involving public services and the operation of public utilities.

Each entity will determine their working hours according to operational requirements to ensure uninterrupted services throughout the holiday.DGHR extended its congratulations to the UAE leadership, citizens and residents on the occasion, reaffirming its pride in the nation's achievements and the Founding Fathers' legacy of unity and belonging, and wishing the UAE continued security, stability, prosperity and progress.

Каждое ведомство самостоятельно определит график работы для обеспечения непрерывности сервисов.
